name: Four-Week Running Meditation Transfer
description:
Standalone 4-week running meditation overlay aligned to the Four-Week Running Calibration — Patched routine. It does not alter mileage, intensity, HR calibration, strides, drills, steady checks, long runs, or diagnostic testing. Its purpose is to transfer seated meditation skills into running by reducing adversarial rumination and improving sensory presence during easy, recovery, and long runs.

Source running bundle: Four-Week Running Calibration — Patched (four-week-running-calibration-patched), routine four-week-running-calibration-patched-routine, 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-26, relationship overlay_only_no_running_load_changes.

Primary goal: Notice adversarial rumination earlier during runs and disengage without completing the imaginary argument.

Success condition: Argument loops may still appear, but they are noticed earlier, completed less often, shorter in duration, and lower in emotional charge.

Default anchors: foot strike, breath rhythm, arm swing, visual field, ambient sound, whole-body running sensation.

Default labels: arguing, rehearsing, planning, remembering, judging, thinking, body, sound, effort.

Metric specs: argument_loop_count: Argument-loop count; longest_loop_duration: Longest loop duration; detection_speed (1-5): Detection speed; disengagement_success (1-5): Disengagement success; emotional_charge (1-5): Emotional charge; present_moment_fraction: Present-moment fraction; post_run_clarity (1-5): Post-run mental clarity; practice_interference (0-5): Practice interference with running execution.

Analysis notes: Treat Day 1 as a non-intervention baseline mental drift audit. Treat Day 22 as a within-run split test between natural mind and deliberate noting. Use long-run overlays on Days 6, 13, 20, and 27 to assess transfer under longer duration. Do not compare diagnostic-day mental metrics against easy-day metrics. If practice_interference is high on any run, reduce the next overlay duration rather than forcing the protocol.

routine_specs.name: Four-Week Running Meditation Transfer
routine_specs.notes: Overlay routine aligned to the running calibration plan. It does not change mileage or intensity. It adds mental-practice instructions and metrics for adversarial rumination during runs. Depends on running routine four-week-running-calibration-patched-routine; this bundle is an overlay and does not change the running plan. Design rules: Do not alter prescribed running distance, duration, RPE, workout type, or calibration instructions. Use scored running meditation mainly on easy, recovery, and long runs. Do not score meditation during strides, drills, or the LTHR diagnostic portion; use simple execution cues instead. Separate running-meditation metrics from running performance and HR calibration metrics. The goal is not blank mind. The goal is earlier detection and non-completion of adversarial thought loops.
